name: Science & Discovery
summary: AI models run in operational weather forecasting, design proteins and help resolve some open math problems; governments fund AI-driven labs, but clinical and lab validation lag.

regions.name: Protein design & biology
regions.summary: Open models design proteins and predict how DNA variants affect gene regulation. Investors are funding AI drug design heavily, but success in the clinic is not yet shown.

landmarks.name: AlphaGenome published in Nature
landmarks.summary: Google DeepMind model reads megabase-long DNA sequences to predict regulatory variant effects; free for non-commercial use via API, with code and weights released.

landmarks.name: RFdiffusion3 open-sourced
landmarks.summary: Baker lab's all-atom model designs proteins that bind molecules commonly found in cells, ten times faster than RFdiffusion2; training code and weights released.

landmarks.name: Isomorphic Labs raises $2.1B Series B
landmarks.summary: DeepMind's drug-design spinout raised $2.1B led by Thrive Capital, with Alphabet, GV, MGX, Temasek, CapitalG and the UK Sovereign AI Fund, to advance its drug pipeline.

regions.whyItMatters: Biology is where AI-for-science has its clearest wins, and drug trials will test whether they turn into medicines.
regions.openQuestion: Will AI-designed drugs succeed in human trials at a higher rate than conventionally discovered ones?

deepDives.title: AlphaGenome: AI for better understanding the genome
deepDives.why: DeepMind's plain-language explainer of what the model predicts and its limits.

deepDives.title: Leveraging genomic deep learning models for the prediction of noncoding variant effects
deepDives.why: Nature Genetics review of how sequence models are used to interpret noncoding variants.

deepDives.title: De novo Design of All-atom Biomolecular Interactions with RFdiffusion3
deepDives.why: The preprint behind RFdiffusion3, with methods and design benchmarks.

deepDives.title: CASP Prediction Center
deepDives.why: Home of CASP, the long-running blind test of protein structure prediction methods.

regions.name: Materials & chemistry
regions.summary: AI models propose millions of candidate materials and well-funded startups build AI-run labs to test them; no clearly useful new material has yet come out of the effort.

landmarks.name: Periodic Labs $300M seed
landmarks.summary: Startup founded by former OpenAI and Google DeepMind researchers raised a $300M seed to build AI scientists and autonomous labs for materials discovery.

landmarks.name: Materials AI must leave the computer
landmarks.summary: MIT Technology Review: startups such as Lila Sciences and Periodic Labs bet on AI-run labs, since synthesis is the bottleneck and no breakthrough material has emerged yet.

landmarks.name: Periodic Neon lab-trained model
landmarks.summary: Periodic Labs post-trained a 1-trillion-parameter open-weight model on its lab data to analyse X-ray diffraction; it reports 55.3% on its internal FrontierXRD test.
landmarks.note: Company-reported result on an internal benchmark; not independently tested.

regions.whyItMatters: New materials underpin batteries, chips and energy, but a prediction only counts once it is made and measured.
regions.openQuestion: Can AI-driven labs deliver a useful new material that is synthesized, verified and adopted by industry?

deepDives.title: Matbench Discovery
deepDives.why: Leaderboard ranking machine learning models on predicting stable crystals.

deepDives.title: Millions of new materials discovered with deep learning
deepDives.why: DeepMind's 2023 account of GNoME, the result later critics said lacked novelty and utility.

deepDives.title: A generative model for inorganic materials design
deepDives.why: Microsoft's MatterGen paper in Nature, a key reference for generative materials design.

deepDives.title: Materials Project
deepDives.why: Open database of computed material properties used to train and test models.

regions.name: Mathematics & formal proof
regions.summary: LLMs paired with Lean verification are resolving open Erdős problems, with proofs checked by machine. Success rates on hard problems stay low and many wins are on easier ones.

landmarks.name: Erdős #397 answered and formalized
landmarks.summary: Neel Somani used ChatGPT (GPT-5.2 Pro) to show the equation has infinitely many solutions, a negative answer; Harmonic's Aristotle formally verified the counterexample.

landmarks.name: AlphaProof Nexus on Erdős problems
landmarks.summary: DeepMind preprint: its best agent, pairing LLMs with Lean proof checking, resolved 9 of 353 open Erdős problems and proved 44 of 492 OEIS conjectures.

landmarks.name: FrontierMath Erdős benchmark
landmarks.summary: Epoch AI and Thomas Bloom chose 68 hard open Erdős problems; a solve needs a Lean proof within a $300 budget. The best model at launch solved about 3%.

regions.whyItMatters: Machine-checked proofs make math the one research field where an AI's claimed result can be verified outright.
regions.openQuestion: Can AI go beyond easier open problems to results mathematicians consider deep or surprising?

deepDives.title: FrontierMath Erdős
deepDives.why: Model scores on 68 hard Erdős problems, with every solve, Lean proof and transcript listed.

deepDives.title: Erdős Problems
deepDives.why: Thomas Bloom's catalogue of Erdős problems, where solutions, including AI ones, are logged and discussed.

deepDives.title: Advancing Mathematics Research with AI-Driven Formal Proof Search
deepDives.why: The AlphaProof Nexus paper: how LLM agents and Lean were run at scale on open problems.

deepDives.title: AI in math: Data & research
deepDives.why: Epoch's hub for benchmarks and analysis on AI progress in mathematics.

regions.name: Weather & climate
regions.summary: AI forecast models run operationally at ECMWF and NOAA at a fraction of the compute of physics models, and developers report gains on cyclone forecasts.

landmarks.name: WeatherNext open-sourced
landmarks.summary: Google DeepMind released code and weights for WeatherNext 2 and WeatherNext Cyclones; its Nature paper reports over a day of extra cyclone forecast lead time.

landmarks.name: ECMWF AIFS upgraded to v2
landmarks.summary: Europe's forecast centre moved its single and ensemble AI models to version 2, adding its first data-driven wave and snow cover forecasts.

landmarks.name: NOAA deploys AIGFS, AIGEFS and HGEFS
landmarks.summary: NOAA put AI global models into operations; it says the 31-member AIGEFS ensemble needs about 9% of the computing of its physics-based GEFS.

regions.whyItMatters: Weather is the clearest case of AI models moving from papers into public operational services.
regions.openQuestion: How well do AI models handle storm intensity and extremes outside their training data, and who validates them?

deepDives.title: AIFS Machine Learning data
deepDives.why: Live open forecast data and documentation for ECMWF's operational AI models.

deepDives.title: WeatherBench 2
deepDives.why: Up-to-date like-for-like scores for AI and physics-based global weather models.

deepDives.title: NOAA Project EAGLE overview
deepDives.why: How NOAA builds and evaluates the AI models behind AIGFS and AIGEFS.

deepDives.title: WP-MIP: AI, hybrid and physically based model intercomparison
deepDives.why: A like-for-like comparison of AI, hybrid and physics-based weather models.

regions.name: Physics & fusion
regions.summary: Machine learning predicts and controls tokamak plasma behavior in real experiments, and fusion developers build AI simulators and digital twins to plan operations before first plasma.

landmarks.name: PPPL PACMAN control framework
landmarks.summary: Princeton framework unifying ML plasma controllers was tested on DIII-D; in one experiment a model predicted a tearing mode about 200 ms in advance.

landmarks.name: DeepMind partners with CFS
landmarks.summary: Google DeepMind and Commonwealth Fusion Systems use the open-source TORAX simulator and reinforcement learning to plan SPARC operation before it is switched on.

landmarks.name: CFS to lead Genesis fusion digital twin
landmarks.summary: US DOE picked Commonwealth Fusion Systems to lead a Genesis Mission Phase II project: an AI-enabled digital twin of SPARC with 10 lab, university and industry partners.

regions.whyItMatters: Fusion needs fast, reliable plasma control, and ML controllers are now being tested on real machines.
regions.openQuestion: Will ML control proven on research tokamaks transfer to burning plasmas in SPARC and ITER-class devices?

deepDives.title: Enabling Integrated AI Control on DIII-D
deepDives.why: The PACMAN paper: control system design and the experiments run on DIII-D.

deepDives.title: Avoiding fusion plasma tearing instability with deep reinforcement learning
deepDives.why: 2024 Nature paper showing an RL controller avoiding tearing instabilities on DIII-D.

deepDives.title: TORAX: Tokamak transport simulation in JAX
deepDives.why: Documentation for the open-source plasma simulator used for control and planning work.

deepDives.title: How AI will help get fusion from lab to grid
deepDives.why: Non-technical explainer of where AI is used in fusion simulation, control and materials.

regions.name: Autonomous labs & AI scientists
regions.summary: Agent systems that read papers, run analyses and propose hypotheses are being deployed in pharma R&D, and the US DOE has selected nearly 300 AI-for-science projects.

landmarks.name: DOE Genesis Mission challenges
landmarks.summary: US Energy Department named 26 science and technology challenges for its AI-for-science mission, including AI-driven autonomous laboratories.

landmarks.name: First Genesis Mission projects selected
landmarks.summary: DOE selected its first 278 Genesis Mission projects, spanning all 50 states, to build and demonstrate AI-enabled scientific workflows.

landmarks.name: Incyte deploys Kosmos AI scientist
landmarks.summary: Edison Scientific said its Kosmos agent will be embedded in Incyte's R&D, starting with target discovery, target validation and translational biology.

regions.whyItMatters: If agents can run parts of the research loop, the pace of science could change well beyond any single field.
regions.openQuestion: Do AI scientist systems produce findings that hold up to independent replication, or mainly plausible analyses?

deepDives.title: Kosmos: An AI Scientist for Autonomous Discovery
deepDives.why: The paper behind Kosmos: how the agent runs long literature and data-analysis cycles.

deepDives.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist
deepDives.why: Google's multi-agent hypothesis generation system, with its experimental validation cases.

deepDives.title: Genesis Mission
deepDives.why: DOE's hub for the mission: challenges, platform, awards and news as they are announced.

deepDives.title: Google DeepMind and Edison Are Building the AI Scientist
deepDives.why: GEN's survey of the main AI scientist efforts and how they differ.

deepDives.title: Science in the age of AI
deepDives.why: Royal Society's 2024 report on how AI is changing the methods and nature of research.

deepDives.title: Genesis Mission National Science and Technology Challenges
deepDives.why: The US government's list of the science problems it wants AI aimed at.

deepDives.title: AI in math: Data & research
deepDives.why: Benchmarks and analysis tracking AI progress on research-level mathematics.

deepDives.title: AIFS Machine Learning data
deepDives.why: Open data from an AI model running in an operational forecasting service.

deepDives.why: Review of sequence models in genomics, a leading area of AI for biology.
